sources.text: Outcome framework O-3 defines sustained employment as paid work maintained for at least six months.
Programme spreadsheet: 27 participants reported placed in paid work during 2026 Q3; follow-up duration was not recorded.
Monitoring note: no six-month follow-up records were included, so sustained employment cannot be established from this dataset.
